provenance_gaps: G1 — CRITICAL: no commit SHA recorded in-repo. Nothing in the repository states which upstream revision was vendored; scripts/setup_vlntube.sh clones unpinned upstream main, so a reproducing reader may receive a different tree than the one our results were produced with. Recoverable now: 7ef6afe22014f13fd97a2d4910f84fd6603e17af.
G2 — no vendoring date recorded. Bounded only by inference: upstream commit 2026-04-25, vendored file mtimes 2026-06-10, first committed in 67b0383 (2026-06-10).
G3 — no content digest recorded in-repo; nothing lets a reader verify their copy offline. Closed by this audit: sha256:965e4db0f8c59fa1d119de1858184bb447d954d8485cccee1db0c664b835bf75.
G4 — upstream publishes no tag, release or version number, so the commit SHA is the only possible version identifier. This makes G1 mandatory rather than optional. Not fixable on our side.

G5 — no software citation entry exists: no CITATION.cff, no BibTeX @software entry, no reference-list entry. docs/paper/FleetSafe_VLN_Paper_Draft.md:234 lists VLNTube as a bare URL under a heading shared with peer-reviewed works, which invites the reader to assume a publication exists.

G6 — no archival snapshot or DOI. Hosted on a personal GitHub account with no institutional mirror, no Zenodo deposit and no Software Heritage archive; note the copyright holder is an institution but the host is a personal account, an elevated disappearance risk. Mitigated in practice because the full tree is vendored in-repo.

G7 — upstream provenance of VLNTube itself is unstated: the upstream repository has no description, homepage, paper link or author list, and authorship is asserted only by the MIT copyright line. The VLNTube/VLNVerse relationship is documented by neither party and must not be asserted as fact.
publication_finding: No peer-reviewed, preprint, or DOI-registered VLNTube publication exists. Four independent authoritative indexes (arXiv, DBLP, OpenAlex, Crossref) each returned a hard zero. Semantic Scholar was rate-limited (HTTP 429) and is recorded as inconclusive; it does not alter the conclusion.
publication_cross_check: The VLNVerse paper (arXiv:2512.19021) does not contain the string 'VLNTube' anywhere, nor 'IAmGoodNavigator'; it refers to its data pipeline only descriptively as a 'two-stage generation pipeline'. The VLNTube repository likewise never names the VLNVerse paper. The VLNVerse paper therefore MUST NOT be cited as the VLNTube publication.
